problem.title: LiTAMIN2 KITTI Odom seq 07 full: elevation correction ablation
problem.question: Ablation: does the KITTI +0.205 deg elevation correction (used by upstream KISS-ICP and CT-ICP) change LiTAMIN2? Whether the LiTAMIN2 paper used it has not been checked, so the corrected variant is kept out of Table 6.

variants.label: coarse_to_fine_3_2_1 (Table 6 variant on seq 07, raw scans)
coarse_to_fine_3_2_1 (Table 6 variant on seq 07, raw scans) + KITTI 0.205 deg elevation correction
variants.intent: Same variant with the HDL-64E +0.205 deg elevation correction applied to every scan before downsampling.
